metadata.purpose: Witnesses G2+FG2+FP-synt. Degenerate: FP at T means boxtimes(T)=T (G2 vacuous).
metadata.warning: FP at T is degenerate. For non-degenerate G2+FG2+FP, search at size 4.
metadata.long_description: G2=T FG2=T FP=T. All three properties hold. The FP is at T itself: boxtimes(T)=T. G2 holds vacuously (boxtimes(T)=T not <=bot in non-collapsed model). FG2: boxtimes^2(T)=T<=T=boxtimes(T). Warning: having boxtimes(T)=T is a degenerate case where the consistency statement is self-provably consistent. This is not the canonical G2+FG2+FP scenario.
